
### HTTP redirects


```
HTTP/1.1 301 Moved Permanently
Location: https://foo.com/quux/bar
Content-Type: text/plain

(This text may be shown by clients that don't process the
redirect automatically, or if there's a problem following
it. It is up to the server what to put here, but typical
might be something like:)

Redirecting to https://foo.com/quux/bar

```


### HTTP redirect codes 


* a bunch of different status codes: 

   * 301 Moved Permanently
   * 302 Found
   * 303 See Other
   * 307 Temporary Redirect
   * 308 Permanent Redirect

* mostly behave all the same, but…  

   * POST request receiving 301/302 redirects into GET request
